AAP Leaders Booked Over Gurdwara Bangla Sahib Incident

Delhi Chief Minister Arvind Kejriwal and other Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) leaders have been booked following a complaint by the Delhi Sikh Gurdwara Management Committee (DSGMC) regarding a 'ruckus' at Gurdwara Bangla Sahib. The AAP has condemned the entry of Delhi Police personnel into the Gurdwara premises.
